plaster.prompt: Aged 1920s apartment interior lime plaster, muted gray-green warm off-white, subtle hand-troweled mineral variation, restrained hairline wear and tiny age speckles.
plaster.avoid: objects, corners, borders, large cracks, graffiti, stains, text, watermark, perspective, baked lighting

brick.prompt: Aged dark red-brown structural brick with pale worn mortar, irregular prewar apartment basement masonry.
brick.avoid: perspective, dramatic damage, missing bricks, moss, text, watermark, baked lighting

concrete.prompt: Poured concrete with restrained aggregate, faint form variation, old apartment basement utility finish.
concrete.avoid: formwork seams, large cracks, stains, objects, text, watermark, perspective, baked lighting

floor_oak.prompt: Narrow-strip aged oak apartment flooring, warm medium brown, subtle wear, period-appropriate satin finish.
floor_oak.avoid: perspective, room edges, furniture, large damage, text, watermark, baked reflections or lighting

terrazzo.prompt: Historic warm-gray terrazzo with small muted cream, charcoal, and brown aggregate chips, understated apartment lobby finish.
terrazzo.avoid: tile seams, borders, perspective, objects, text, watermark, baked reflections or lighting

wainscot.prompt: Aged painted plaster wainscot surface in muted institutional green, subtle roller texture and restrained age variation.
wainscot.avoid: panels, trim edges, peeling sheets, large scratches, text, watermark, perspective, baked lighting
